vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: pamela-call
Version: 1.1.3

The skill bundle is benign. The `_meta.json` contains standard metadata. The `SKILL.md` provides documentation and code examples for integrating with the Pamela Voice API. It instructs users on installing standard SDK packages (`@thisispamela/sdk`, `thisispamela`), obtaining an API key, and making API calls. There are no prompt injection attempts against the agent, no instructions for unauthorized data exfiltration, malicious execution, persistence, or obfuscation. All commands and instructions are directly related to the stated purpose of making AI-powered phone calls via the Pamela service, with consistent branding across package names and domains (e.g., `thisispamela.com`).
